name: Zetrix Agentic Wallet
description: Zetrix identity, verifiable-credential and pay-per-use wallet tools for agents.

network.label: Zetrix network
network.help: Testnet by default. Mainnet spends real funds.

maxPaymentAmount.label: Maximum payment per call
maxPaymentAmount.help: Maximum per payment, in the token's raw units. Simplest form is one limit for everything: {"*":"1000000000"}. To limit per token, use "ZTX" for the native coin and the CONTRACT ADDRESS for any other — a ticker like "JMYR" never matches and the payment is refused. Defaults to refusing every payment until you set this.

zetrixAddress.label: Existing holder address (optional)
zetrixAddress.help: Leave empty and the wallet creates its own account on first run.
